name: latency_perception
description: Push-to-talk dictation with controlled additional delay before the text appears. Participants rate perceived responsiveness after each trial; workload after each block. Total delay = measured system latency + added delay (both logged per trial).
research_questions: RQ4: At what total release-to-text latency does dictation stop feeling immediate?
RQ5: Does added latency increase perceived workload (raw NASA-TLX) or change speaking behaviour (utterance length, re-dictations)?
